item.title: Orange notification for tropical cyclone ONE-26. Population affected by Category 1 (120 km/h) wind speeds or higher is 0 (10.248 million in Tropical Storm).
item.description: From 22/09/2026 to 24/09/2026, a Tropical Storm (maximum wind speed of 83 km/h) ONE-26 was active in NorthIndian. The cyclone affects these countries: India (vulnerability High). Estimated population affected by category 1 (120 km/h) wind speeds or higher is 0 (10.248 million in tropical storm).

item.title: Orange flood alert in India
item.description: On 09/08/2026, a flood started in India, lasting until 22/09/2026 (last update). The flood caused 42 deaths and 260529 displaced .
